usageNotes: Instructs the QEMU Guest Agent to perform a hybrid suspend (suspend-to-both: writes memory state to disk as in suspend-to-disk, then suspends to RAM), combining fast resume with crash resilience. Requires the QEMU Guest Agent to be installed, running, and responsive inside the VM — the call will fail if the agent is not reachable. The caller needs either VM.PowerMgmt or VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted on /vms/{vmid}; the response wraps the agent's raw result in a result property and is synchronous (no UPID is returned).
tips: The VM must have the QEMU Guest Agent installed and enabled in the VM hardware config (qemu-guest-agent package + agent: 1 in VM options); otherwise this call returns an error.
Hybrid suspend requires the guest OS to support it (Windows supports it natively via hybrid shutdown; Linux requires configured swap for the memory image).
This is a guest-side operation — it tells the OS to suspend itself. For hypervisor-level suspension without guest cooperation, use the node's ACPI or power management endpoints instead.
Unlike suspend-ram, power is not lost on a hybrid suspend, but the memory image on disk means the guest can recover even if power is cut after the call returns.
